title: recon-cli
summary: A single-binary recon tool that chains subdomain enumeration, port scanning, and screenshotting.
description: recon-cli wraps subfinder, naabu, and gowitness behind one command with sane defaults, writing a single markdown report per target for fast manual review.
challenges: Getting consistent output across three underlying tools with different flag conventions.
lessons: A boring, predictable CLI beats a clever one every time you're using it at 2am.
